name: Galvin La Chapelle

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, not Sunday lunch; Classic pairing £80, or Sommelier pairing £130; vegetarian and vegan tasting menus offered

menus.name: Set lunch
menus.note: Monday to Saturday; three courses £55; some dishes carry a supplement

alsoTry.name: Galvin Bistrot & Bar
alsoTry.note: Its more casual sister restaurant in the same building, with an à la carte bistro menu.

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, or by phone or email.
cancellation: Cancelling or changing a booking with less than 48 hours' notice, or not turning up, costs £50 a person. Large or special-date bookings may have a different rule, set out in the confirmation email.
walkIns: The bar is kept for dining guests; there are no drinks-only bookings.
groups: Private dining in The Gallery mezzanine and The Arch room, or the whole restaurant for up to 150 guests. Email privatedining.city@galvinrestaurants.com or call and choose option 2.
dressCode: Smart casual. No flip-flops, sliders, tracksuits, gym trainers, ripped jeans, beachwear, hoodies or leggings.
children: Children of all ages are welcome. Highchairs on request, and a children's menu for under-12s.
byob: Up to two bottles of wine or Champagne per booking, with corkage from £65 a bottle; ask the restaurant first. Not for private dining.
